name: Season margin per game
role: Outcome measure (same games as the target; not predictive)

name: Implied opponent points per game
definition: PTS minus +/- (arithmetic from official per-game values)

name: Home win percentage
definition: Home W / (home W + home L) from standings text
role: Component of the target (overlaps same games; excluded)

name: Road win percentage
definition: Road W / (road W + road L) from standings text
role: Component of the target (overlaps same games; excluded)

name: Last-10 win percentage
definition: Last 10 games W/L from standings text
